# Berlin Conference Week Plan

A balanced 7-day itinerary for **2 attendees** in Berlin from **2026-09-07 to 2026-09-13**, with **Monday–Saturday conference programming** and **Sunday reserved for travel/rest**.
Budget assumption: **EUR 180 per person per day** for food, local transport, and tickets; costs below are estimated **for 2 people**.

## Day-by-Day Conference Schedule and Cost Plan

| Day | Focus | Morning Keynote | Afternoon Workshop | Lunch Break | Evening Networking | Est. Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon, Sep 7 | Opening day, full energy | 09:00–10:15 Opening keynote + conference overview | 13:30–15:30 Track workshops: trends, product, and strategy | 12:00–13:15 Group lunch near venue | 18:30–20:30 Welcome mixer | **EUR 280** |
| Tue, Sep 8 | Packed learning day | 09:00–10:15 Industry keynote | 13:30–16:00 Hands-on technical workshops | 12:00–13:15 Lunch with peers | 19:00–21:00 Sponsor reception | **EUR 300** |
| Wed, Sep 9 | Moderate pace | 09:15–10:00 Leadership keynote | 13:30–15:00 Small-group breakout workshops | 12:00–13:00 Quick lunch | 18:00–20:00 Roundtable networking dinner | **EUR 240** |
| Thu, Sep 10 | Heavier content day | 08:45–10:15 Main-stage keynote | 13:15–16:00 Deep-dive workshops and demos | 12:00–13:00 Lunch on-site | 19:00–21:00 Community meetup | **EUR 320** |
| Fri, Sep 11 | Light-to-medium day | 09:30–10:15 Future-focused keynote | 13:30–15:00 Applied workshop sessions | 12:00–13:15 Lunch break | 17:30–19:30 Networking social | **EUR 230** |
| Sat, Sep 12 | Closing day, lighter schedule | 10:00–11:00 Closing keynote + takeaways | 13:00–14:30 Final workshop / action planning | 12:00–13:00 Lunch break | 18:00–20:00 Farewell drinks | **EUR 220** |
| Sun, Sep 13 | Travel and rest | No conference sessions | No workshops | Flexible meal timing | No formal event; recovery and departure prep | **EUR 140** |

## Cost Balance and Daily Rhythm

- **Packed days:** Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday keep the agenda full for maximum conference value.
- **Lighter days:** Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday reduce intensity to protect energy and leave time for follow-ups.
- **Sunday:** kept open for travel, rest, and buffer time before departure.

### Budget Check
- **Budget cap per day for 2 people:** EUR **360**
- **Highest estimated day:** EUR **320** on Thursday
- **Weekly estimated total for 2 people:** **EUR 1,730**
- **Weekly budget ceiling for 2 people:** **EUR 2,520**
- **Estimated buffer:** **EUR 790**

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: View venues](https://www.visitberlin.de/en)
Action: [Button: Plan transit](https://www.bvg.de/en)

## Sources
- Berlin official visitor info: https://www.visitberlin.de/en
- Berlin public transport: https://www.bvg.de/en
- Conference planning reference: https://www.meetberlin.de/en
